offres.titre: Junior Managers Program (Trainee) - Start your Leadership Journey in HR, Business & Strategy
offres.extrait:
Shape the future of HR and Business with us! We are looking for master’s graduates with entrepreneurial thinking and a drive to make a difference, who want to take on responsibility and prepare for a career in HR or commercial management in our Junior Managers Program. Do you think business-mindedly, act with a people-oriented perspective, and want to develop sustainable solutions for Bosch? Then we want to hear from you.​
 Over an intensive 12 to 24-month journey, you will combine HR and commercial rotations in Germany and abroad, work on strategically relevant projects, and build a comprehensive understanding of how people, organization, and business success interact. Depending on your profile and development goals, you will gain insights into areas such as HR Strategy, Digitalization, HR Business Partnering, Talent Management, and Organizational Development, as well as Controlling, Finance, or Business Development. Your mission: connect business-driven decisions with a strong people perspective.​

 We are especially interested in AI-driven, data-savvy professionals with a strong ambition to shape the future of operations, with experience in: 
 1) Cost & Productivity Reinvention Our Cost & Productivity Reinvention practice partners with C-suite leaders to turn operational complexity into competitive advantage. We design and deliver large-scale cost transformation programs—combining AI, advanced analytics and deep functional expertise to improve cost discipline, reduce margin pressure and unlock hidden value across operations, supply chain and procurement, always anchored in measurable business outcomes. 
 2) End-to-end Supply Chain & Operations Transformation Shape and deliver large-scale SC&O transformations, driving initiatives across logistics, fulfillment, transportation, planning, procurement, and operations.
